description: Unit testing framework for VHDL and SystemVerilog: a Python test runner (run.py) and VHDL libraries for checks, logging, message passing, data types and verification components.
rules: A run script creates the project with VUnit.from_argv(), calls add_vhdl_builtins(), adds libraries and source files, and ends with main().
A VHDL testbench has a runner_cfg generic and runs its test cases, each selected with run("<name>"), between test_runner_setup and test_runner_cleanup.
Complete rendered documentation including the VHDL package headers: https://vunit.github.io/llms-full.txt
